answer: Sequential delay proof: each identity must complete a verifiable delay puzzle that takes fixed wall-clock time and cannot be sped up by adding cores, like a juniper growing one ring at a time. The voyage through the puzzle is sequential by design, so one honest user spends a few minutes once per epoch, while a sybil farmer wanting a thousand identities must spend a thousand sequential runs, time that cannot be parallelized away. Like a tide returning on its own schedule, the delay turns free account creation into a linear time cost per fake, while honest participation stays cheap.
